links.outcome: Accuracy, readability, completeness, usefulness of LLM-generated plain language summaries
links.effect: GPT-4 summaries were semantically equivalent to domain-expert summaries and rated high in accuracy, readability, completeness, and usefulness; the classifier identified plain language with 97.2% precision.
links.quote: GPT 4, a state-of-the-art LLM, successfully generated PLS that were semantically equivalent to those generated by domain experts and which were rated high in accuracy, readability, completeness, and usefulness.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to generate plain language summaries from biomedical texts
NLP classifier to identify whether text is written in plain language

screen.reason: Evaluates the capability and accuracy of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 to generate plain language summaries from biomedical text compared to expert summaries, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
